name: UIS-QA
description: UIS-QA is the first dedicated benchmark for Unindexed Information Seeking, containing 110 expert-annotated QA pairs that test the ability of agents to retrieve information not indexed by search engines, such as overlooked content, dynamic webpages, and embedded files.
reputation: A very new benchmark with little to no established community adoption yet, but it targets an important and underexplored retrieval setting.
notes: Highlights a critical blind spot in current agents relying on search-engine-indexed knowledge; shows significant performance drop on this benchmark.
